# Read the memos sent to Nvidia employees after Jensen Huang's resignation

...

2026-11-12T15:54:22.900Z 

Nvidia's new leaders sought to reassure employees Thursday after Jensen Huang abruptly resigned from the company he cofounded more than three decades ago following reports of extramarital affairs.

Interim CEO Colette Kress and newly appointed board chair Harvey Jones addressed the leadership shake-up and laid out the company's next steps, according to internal memos obtained by Business Insider.

Kress said leadership would host a company meeting on November 18 about Nvidia's future, while Jones said the company's board was searching for a permanent successor and considering both internal and external candidates.

body: Read the memos sent to Nvidia employees after Jensen Huang's resignation

Soeren Stache/picture alliance via Getty ImagesJensen Huang, cofounder and CEO of Nvidia, speaks during GTC Berlin.
Nvidia's new leaders sought to reassure employees Thursday after Jensen Huang abruptly resigned from the company he cofounded more than three decades ago following reports of extramarital affairs.

Interim CEO Colette Kress and newly appointed board chair Harvey Jones addressed the leadership shake-up and laid out the company's next steps, according to internal memos obtained by Business Insider.

Kress said leadership would host a company meeting on November 18 about Nvidia's future, while Jones said the company's board was searching for a permanent successor and considering both internal and external candidates.

Dear NVIDIANs,I believe deeply in this company and in its future. More than anything, I believe in each of you, in our customers and partners and in the vital role we play every day in the global economy.The Board, Estaff and I recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period and I want you to know how grateful we are for your resilience, professionalism and continued dedication. Thank you.This company has achieved so much because of the work that all of you bring to it every single day. You are our greatest strength. You will hear more from leadership in the coming days about our future together, and we will host a company meeting on November 18 at 9am PT.We play a vital role in building the technology that is powering the AI revolution, and we have important work ahead of us. So let's move forward together, with the same determination and commitment that have always defined this company.Thank you for all you do,Colette

Dear NVIDIA Employees,I am writing to share an important update. Jensen has resigned as CEO and Board Member, and the Board has asked our Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress to serve as interim CEO while it conducts a search for a permanent successor looking at both internal and external candidates. I will serve as the first-ever Chair of the Board.As CFO for over 13 years, Colette has been a key architect of NVIDIA's growth and capital strategy. She possesses a deep understanding of this business and the markets in which we operate. The Board has full confidence in Colette to deliver on our commitments to shareholders, customers, partners, and to each of you.Jensen's contributions to NVIDIA are profound. NVIDIA is one of the most consequential technology companies in the world. We pioneered accelerated computing, defined the modern GPU, and built the platform that powered artificial intelligence.The Board takes seriously our duty as stewards of this great company.The strength of this company resides in our employees, leadership team, technical strength and partner ecosystem. I am confident that under Colette's leadership, with the full support of the Board, we will continue to grow our business, and lead the industry forward. Thank you for your focus, your professionalism, and your commitment to NVIDIA.Harvey JonesChair, NVIDIA Board of Directors

issues.digest: 英伟达创始人兼CEO黄仁勋因婚外情报道突然辞职，引发公司内部震动。临时CEO科莱特·克雷斯与董事会主席哈维·琼斯向全体员工发送备忘录，试图稳定军心。克雷斯宣布将于11月18日召开全员会议，讨论公司未来；琼斯则确认董事会正在物色永久继任者，并强调对克雷斯的信任。备忘录中，两人均赞扬黄仁勋的深远贡献，同时呼吁员工保持专注与专业。这篇报道披露了英伟达权力交接初期的内部沟通细节，展现了这家AI巨头在领导层动荡中的应对策略，值得关注其后续发展。
points: 黄仁勋因婚外情报道辞去CEO及董事会职务，英伟达领导层紧急调整。
临时CEO克雷斯宣布11月18日召开全员会议，并感谢员工的韧性。
董事会主席琼斯表示正寻找永久继任者，内部外部候选人均在考虑，并对克雷斯领导能力表示充分信心。
